description: Security gate: scan code before shipping commands (git commit, push, PR)

hooks.command: if python3 -c 0 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre_commit_scan.py; elif python -c 0 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre_commit_scan.py; else py -3 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre_commit_scan.py; fi

$p = 'python'; $a = @(); if (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $p = 'py'; $a = @('-3') } elseif (-not (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { $p = 'python3' }; $input | & $p @a "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre_commit_scan.py" --stdout-json; exit $LASTEXITCODE

if python3 -c 0 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/protect_scan_pass.py; elif python -c 0 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/protect_scan_pass.py; else py -3 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/protect_scan_pass.py; fi
